about.title: About MaweshiAI
about.body: MaweshiAI helps buyers at livestock markets check an animal before paying: species, breed, age from the teeth and signs of disease, with clear advice for their purpose.
about.university: MUET Jamshoro · Final Year Design Project

check.purposeTitle: Why are you buying this animal?

tips.front: Keep the full animal in frame, avoid backlight
tips.back: Stand behind the animal and fit the rump and hind legs
tips.left: Stand to the side so the whole body, head to tail, is in frame
tips.right: Same as the left side, from the other side of the animal

check.discardBody: The photos you took will be deleted.

issues.too_dark: Too dark – retake in better light
issues.too_bright: Too bright – avoid direct sun or glare

check.qualityError: Couldn't check this photo. You can still use it.
check.teethHint: Fit the mouth inside the outline
check.permissionBody: MaweshiAI needs the camera to photograph the animal. You can also pick photos from the gallery.
check.reviewSub: Tap a photo to retake it
check.retakeBanner_one: Retake {{count}} photo for a more accurate report
check.retakeBanner_other: Retake {{count}} photos for a more accurate report
check.analyzeAnywayBody: Some photos have problems. The report will be less accurate.
check.failedBody: Something went wrong while checking the animal. Your photos are still here; try again.
check.wrongTitle: This doesn't look like a cow or buffalo
check.wrongBody: MaweshiAI checks cattle and buffalo only. Please take a clear photo of the animal you want to buy.
check.wrongTip: Stand back so the full animal is in frame
